title: Digital Marketing Agency in Atlanta, GA
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Atlanta, GA | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Atlanta businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video, planned by neighbourhood and suburb, inside and outside the Perimeter.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Atlanta businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Atlanta is the business capital of the Southeast: a city of corporate headquarters, film sets, music studios and universities, surrounded by suburbs that stretch across many counties. We plan campaigns around where in that wide metro area your customers live and work.

sections.heading: Inside and outside the Perimeter
paragraphs: Atlantans divide their region by Interstate 285, the ring road known as the Perimeter. Inside it are the city's best-known districts: Downtown with its convention centre and stadiums, Midtown with offices, arts venues and Georgia Tech, and Buckhead with high-end retail and finance. East-side neighbourhoods such as Inman Park, Old Fourth Ward, Virginia-Highland and Grant Park are full of restaurants and independent shops, many of them linked by the BeltLine trail. West Midtown has turned warehouses into design showrooms and dining.

Outside the Perimeter are the suburbs where a great many households and employers are found: Sandy Springs and Dunwoody around Perimeter Center, Alpharetta and its technology offices, Marietta and Smyrna in Cobb County, Duluth and Lawrenceville in Gwinnett, and Decatur just east of the city. Each behaves as its own local market.

sections.heading: Traffic decides who your customers are
paragraphs: Atlanta's congestion is well known, and it shapes buying. People will not cross the metro area at rush hour for a dentist, a gym or a restaurant. They choose within a comfortable drive, and they search by neighbourhood, suburb or county. The many streets that share the name Peachtree add to the need for precise location details.
A campaign that targets all of Atlanta pays for clicks from people who will never make the trip. We set up local marketing around realistic travel.
bullets: Pages for the neighbourhoods and suburbs you serve, named as locals name them.
Ad radius and schedules based on drive time, not straight-line distance.
A Google Business Profile for each physical location, with accurate categories and photos.
Separate budgets for areas inside and outside the Perimeter when they perform differently.
Call, form and booking tracking tied back to revenue.

sections.heading: Headquarters, studios and start-ups
paragraphs: Atlanta hosts the head offices of global consumer brands, a major airline and large logistics and retail groups, and its airport makes it a natural base for regional sales teams and conventions. Around them are agencies, consultancies, software firms and payment companies that sell to other businesses. They need websites that explain a complex offer simply, search content for the problems buyers research, and paid campaigns aimed at job roles.

The city is also a production centre. Film and television work has brought studios, equipment houses and crews, and Atlanta's music scene has shaped popular culture far beyond Georgia. Creative businesses here are judged on their reel. Strong video, a fast portfolio site and an active social presence matter more for them than keyword volume. Georgia Tech, Emory and the historically Black colleges of the Atlanta University Center supply graduates and a steady flow of new ventures.

sections.heading: A calendar full of events
paragraphs: Conventions, college football, professional sport, concerts and festivals bring visitors most weeks of the year, and big weekends fill hotels and restaurants downtown and around the Battery in Cobb County. Spring pollen and long, hot summers drive seasonal demand for home and car services. We plan budgets and content against the events and seasons that affect your trade.

presence: TDM works with Atlanta businesses remotely. We do not have an office in the city. Strategy, design, development and video editing are delivered online by our team, with scheduled calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Atlanta?
faqs.a: No. We work with Atlanta businesses remotely. Regular video calls, shared documents and reports keep the work visible to you.

faqs.q: Should I market to all of metro Atlanta or just my area?
faqs.a: For most local businesses, just your area. Customers choose within a manageable drive, so targeting the neighbourhoods and suburbs near you usually brings better enquiries at lower cost. Businesses that deliver or sell online can go wider.

faqs.q: How do I show up in searches for Buckhead, Midtown or Decatur?
faqs.a: Create a useful page for each area you serve, keep your business profile accurate, and earn reviews from customers there. If you have a physical location in a district, make that address and its surroundings clear on the page.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Atlanta?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of the work, the channels and the competition in your field. We provide a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long does it take to launch a campaign?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements and the brief. The timeline is agreed with you in the plan.
